about.title: About AI-native mini-games
about.subtitle: Short games, strong thinking.
about.whatIsNerdleText: AI-native mini-games treat AI as part of the game loop itself. In Gamelet, AI generates, evaluates, and adapts each round in real time so puzzles remain mathematically rigorous while feeling fresh for return players.
about.basicRulesText: We don't add AI as decoration. We use it inside the rule system to create dynamic scenes, valid challenge generation, and personalized pacing while keeping every outcome explainable.
about.principle1: AI creates variation without breaking game rules.
about.principle2: Every challenge keeps clear constraints that are easy to learn and verify.
about.principle3: Sessions are concise and restartable so play fits real attention spans.
about.principle4: Difficulty is adaptive to recent momentum, not random spikes.
about.principle5: Feedback is immediate and actionable, so players can improve quickly.
about.colorFeedbackText: This is not one game only; it's the design direction of Gamelet: a catalog of AI-native micro-games where novelty, fairness, and replay value reinforce each other.
about.experience2: Transparent rules and clear signal feedback
about.experience3: Easy progress from beginner to expert
about.testSkills: Open a puzzle now and feel how AI-native design changes your next decision.

tips.title: Nerdle Answer Today
tips.subtitle: Expert Strategies & Tips for Today's Puzzle
tips.whyNoAnswers: Why We Don't Provide Direct Answers
tips.whyNoAnswersText: We believe the true joy of Nerdle comes from solving the puzzle yourself. Instead of spoiling today's answer, we provide expert strategies and tips to help you develop your problem-solving skills and enjoy the satisfaction of finding the solution independently.
tips.strategy1Desc: Begin with frequently used numbers and operators like simple addition or multiplication
tips.strategy2Desc: Remember PEMDAS - equations follow standard mathematical order
tips.strategy3Desc: Use gray tiles to rule out numbers and operators not in the equation
tips.strategy4Desc: Yellow tiles tell you the element exists - try different positions
tips.strategy5Desc: Consider what makes mathematical sense given the equation length
tips.tip2: Division often results in remainders - stick to clean divisions
tips.tip3: The result must be a positive integer
tips.tip4: Don't forget about subtraction - it's less common but valid
tips.tip5: Save your guesses - think before you type
tips.useTheseStrategies: Use these expert tips to solve today's Nerdle puzzle without spoilers.
